      • creationTime

        @NameInMap(value="CreationTime")
public String creationTime

        The time when the cluster was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

        example:

        2021-10-21T02:57:08Z

      • description

        @NameInMap(value="Description")
public String description

        The name of the cluster.

        example:

        GadTest

      • gadInstanceMembers

        @NameInMap(value="GadInstanceMembers")
public List<DescribeGadInstancesResponseBody.DescribeGadInstancesResponseBodyGadInstancesGadInstanceMembers> gadInstanceMembers

        The list of nodes in the cluster.

      • gadInstanceName

        @NameInMap(value="GadInstanceName")
public String gadInstanceName

        The ID of the GAD cluster.

        example:

        gad-rm-bp1npi2j8****

      • modificationTime

        @NameInMap(value="ModificationTime")
public String modificationTime

        The time when the cluster was last modified. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

        example:

        2021-10-21T03:01:20Z

      • service

        @NameInMap(value="Service")
public String service

        The database engine of the GAD cluster.

        Only mysql is supported.

        example:

        mysql

      • status

        @NameInMap(value="Status")
public String status

        The status of the cluster. Valid values:

        • activation: running
        • creating: being created
        • replica_adding: adding nodes
        example:

        activation
